actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The package's model is the MJCF scene agilex_piper/scene.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco model="piper_scene">' and which includes piper.xml
piper.xml declares '<compiler angle="radian" meshdir="assets"/>', so the joint ranges of the model are radians and its meshes are resolved from assets/
The model uses the implicitfast integrator with an elliptic friction cone and impratio 10, and its <option> element sets no timestep
The piper default class sets frictionloss 0.3 and armature 0.005 on its joints and gives its position actuators inheritrange 1 and forcerange -100 to 100
The finger default class inherits the piper class and overrides the joints to type slide with frictionloss 0 and the position actuators to forcerange -10 to 10
The body base_link sets childclass piper, so the joints and geoms below it use the piper defaults
joint1 is a hinge with range -2.618 to 2.618 rad
joint2 is a hinge with range 0 to 3.14 rad
joint3 is a hinge with range -2.697 to 0 rad
joint4 is a hinge with range -1.832 to 1.832 rad
joint5 is a hinge with range -1.22 to 1.22 rad
joint6 is a hinge with range -3.14 to 3.14 rad
joint7 is a slide joint with range 0 to 0.035 m
joint8 is a slide joint with range -0.035 to 0 m
The model has seven position actuators: joint1 to joint6, and a gripper actuator on joint7
The gripper actuator of joint7 has kp 40 and kv 5; joint1 to joint3 have kp 80 and kv 5, joint4 has kp 40 and kv 5, and joint5 and joint6 have kp 10 and kv 1.5
joint7 and joint8 are coupled by an equality constraint with polycoef '0 -1 0 0 0', so the right finger mimics the left
The model has a home keyframe with qpos '0 1.57 -1.3485 0 0 0 0 0' and ctrl '0 1.57 -1.3485 0 0 0 0'
The package's description is a simplified MJCF of the AgileX PiPER, derived from the publicly available PiPER ROS model
The model adds position controlled actuators
The scene adds a textured groundplane, a skybox and haze
The model requires MuJoCo 2.3.4 or later

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge takes no seed input and cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults, so a run repeats exactly on the same engine but no seed selects a different state

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the model file for the actuator control ranges and the joint count but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts and actuator dynamics are not MuJoCo's
no mesh or texture of the asset directory is loaded and no contact, equality or tendon constraint is resolved by the stand-in; the joint7/joint8 finger equality of the model is not applied
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
no rendering is offered and no physical PiPER robot is modelled; nothing was validated against the AgileX hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
